values.note: Beulah RV Park 2026 Fees Schedule: spring (May 1 - Memorial Day weekend) and fall (Labor Day - Sept 30) $50/night on every lot; June special daily rates lake front $85, lake view $50; summer weekly (Independence Day weekend - Labor Day, Saturday to Saturday) lake front $750, lake view $500; summer daily as available, lake lot $125, lake view $75. No resident/non-resident difference. Water, sewer and electric included. Payment in full at reservation. Mooring (own recoil line) $10/day or $50/week; propane fire pit $15/day or $60/week.

fees.source: https://www.villageofbeulah.net/RV%20Park%20Camper%20Rules-Weekly%20Contract-%20Approved%202026.pdf ('Beulah RV Park – 2026 Fees Schedule': Spring/Fall '$50 per night'; June 'Lake Front $85.00' / 'Lake View $50.00'; Summer Weekly 'Lake Front $750.00' / 'Lake View $500.00'; Summer Daily 'Lake Lot $125.00' / 'Lake View $75.00'; approved 13 Jan 2026) + campground page ('May and September all lots are $50 per night'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://www.villageofbeulah.net/RV%20Park%20Camper%20Rules-Weekly%20Contract-%20Approved%202026.pdf (2026 Fees Schedule seasons: 'Spring May 1- Memorial Day Weekend' ... 'Fall Labor Day–Sept 30'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.villageofbeulah.net/RV%20Park%20Camper%20Rules-Weekly%20Contract-%20Approved%202026.pdf ('Water, Sewer, and Electric are included in the Rate. All sewers must have a sanitary seal around the sewer hose that fits securely into the sewer pipe'), read 2026-10-22; amperage not stated

values.note: Book online (ResNexus), with the RV Park Manager 231-651-9710, or off-season at the Village office (231-882-4451). Two-night minimum on every rate; lake-front lots from Independence Day weekend to Labor Day are let by the week only (Saturday to Saturday, one-week minimum, two-week maximum); in summer other lots are daily 'as available'. June daily reservations need three nights. Check-out 11 am; arrivals coordinated with the manager.

booking.source: https://www.villageofbeulah.net/RV%20Park%20Camper%20Rules-Weekly%20Contract-%20Approved%202026.pdf ('Two Day Minimum'; Summer Weekly Lake Front 'One Week Minimum Two Week Maximum'; 'Posted weekly rates will apply Saturday through Saturday'; 'Reservations for the month of June special daily rates will apply with a Three Day Minimum'; 'Make reservations and payments by credit card online ... with the RV Park Manager 231-651-9710 or in person') + campground page ('Book Online Here' ResNexus link), read 2026-10-22

note: Village of Beulah municipal RV park on Crystal Lake in downtown Beulah, next to the Betsie Valley Trail. Primarily transient (only a few second-row lots offered seasonally); boat moorings available to campers. No tents. --Claude
summary: Village page and 2026 rules/fee schedule PDF: open May 1 - Sept 30; $50/night spring/fall and June lake view, $85 June lake front, summer lake front weekly only ($750), lake view $500/week or $75 daily, lake lot $125 daily; water/sewer/electric included (amps not stated); ResNexus or phone, two-night minimum, summer lake-front one-week minimum. Added fees, season dates, water/sewer, booking platform/url/min_stay. Note trimmed of booking, season, price commentary and RV Life text. Phone 231-651-9710 (RV Park Manager) matches; Village office 231-882-4451.
